reclaim_authority_context.typed_context: Current immutable PlatformRegistry plus the existing lifespan-owned synchronous research SQLAlchemy sessionmaker; no Session, plan, cutoff, admission, owner, dataset, assessment, mode, or callback.
reclaim_authority_context.lifecycle: One aware UTC cutoff per dispatch; at most one lazy synchronous research Session reused by both actual loader calls and closed on every success, refusal, and exception; disabled research creates none.
reclaim_authority_context.plan_authority: The exact persisted receipt plus the explicit current registry yields one internally reconstructed immutable canonical plan consumed by the sole require_phase4_current verifier; caller plans and second verifiers are forbidden.
reclaim_authority_context.transaction_contract: SQLite acquires admission-scoped BEGIN IMMEDIATE before enumeration; PostgreSQL locks exact deterministic candidates FOR UPDATE. Reconcile and claim conditionally mutate only explicit classified legacy ids with owner/state/admission/cancellation/token/expiry predicates; broad owner updates and fresh selectors are forbidden.
reclaim_authority_context.mixed_rule: Any v2 candidate receives actual-loader preflight and causes owner-level head-of-line refusal with zero mutation for all v1/v2 rows; pure-v1 direct and startup behavior remains byte/row equivalent.
reclaim_authority_context.terminal: A complete current v2 chain reaches exact V2_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE before claim/reconcile/provider/cache/worker/result/broker/order/money effects.
reclaim_authority_context.nonclaim: This schema-free correction does not enable v2 claim or reclaim, Phase 5 runtime, deployment, production, live, or money behavior.

authority_transaction_boundary.ownership: The caller alone owns the outer commit or rollback. The helper enlists the same connection, proves or materializes the physical outer transaction, owns only the nested savepoint, and never commits, rolls back, closes, invalidates, retries, or replaces caller resources.

dialects.sqlite: Before SAVEPOINT, issue explicit BEGIN when the same sqlite driver connection is not in a transaction and verify in_transaction. Refuse an already nested Session without a proof bound before its first savepoint.
dialects.postgresql: Before SAVEPOINT, materialize an idle driver transaction with a harmless statement and verify INTRANS; RELEASE remains inside the caller-owned outer transaction.

authority_transaction_boundary.proof_lifecycle: Bind root SessionTransaction identity, connection identity, and dialect in Session.info; clear only when the root ends; do not clear on inner savepoint end; recheck live driver state on every entry.

seams.fact: execution graph version plus admission receipt
research graph version plus admission receipt
typed segments, manifest, and dependency links
lease heartbeat, result batch, and progress
terminal run state plus execution outbox event
ledger snapshot version plus outbox event; transaction hardening only

authority_transaction_boundary.wrapper_disposition: app.events.outbox.OutboxRepository.writer declares transaction ownership but Session.begin alone is not physical SQLite proof. Ledger write_snapshot must enter the shared boundary directly; other outbox writers have ordinary DML before commit and no current nested-first-write seam.
required_cases: DBAPI commit refusal then caller rollback
authority_transaction_boundary.mutation_rule: One adoption guard for each of seven seams plus physical-root establishment, proof-marker cleanup, unproved-external-nesting refusal, and no helper commit/rollback/close; restore all owned bytes exactly.
transitive_revalidation: backtest job claim batching and terminal outbox
authority_transaction_boundary.nonclaim: No schema, migration, dependency, configuration, service, provider, frontend, deployment, production, runtime-enablement, live, money-authority, or ledger-business-rule change follows.

research_receipt_authority.trigger: Immutable phase4-final-review-4 SPEC/QUALITY FAIL proved that the actual loader could reach V2_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE without ResearchStrategyAdmission or ResearchIrV2GraphVersion, while integration verified them only after loader return.
research_receipt_authority.decision: KEEP + HARDEN; schema-free; no separate integration capsule because implementation owns the bounded integration rerun and package rebuild after byte freeze.
research_receipt_authority.mutation_rule: Kill and byte-restore research-verifier invocation, verifier order, terminal order, and consumer no-side-effect guards.
research_receipt_authority.nonclaim: No schema, migration, dependency, configuration, service, provider, frontend, deployment, production, runtime enablement, live, money, Phase 4 closure, or review-readiness claim follows.

research_json_shape_repair.evidence_scope: SQLite compatibility and isolated PostgreSQL 16 exact-shape, forward-upgrade, restart, preservation, typed-manifest lifecycle, drift-refusal, and mutation evidence only
research_json_shape_repair.nonclaim: Does not accept Phase 4, complete integration/review, prove release deployability or production rehearsal, or grant runtime, provider, frontend, deployment, live, or money authority.

adversarial_matrix.adv_006_phase4_contract: At the real public v2 reclaim-dispatch seam, explicit current authority context verifies the complete current chain and reaches exact V2_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE before claim, reclaim, provider, cache, worker, claim-token, result, broker, order, or money side effects; stale or missing authority refuses earlier. FULL proves containment only.
